}}'''Tavan''' was [[Warder]] to [[Careane Fransi]]. It is unknown whether Tavan is aware that Careane is [[Black Ajah]].

== Appearance ==
He had broad shoulders.

== Activities ==
He was with Careane when she traveled to [[Caemlyn]]. He felt Careane die inside the house on Full Moon Street and rushed inside to confront the Black Ajah [[Aes Sedai]] who had killed her. It is assumed he died in the confrontation.
